name: Bernie Mullane Sports Complex
access_notes: Multi-purpose indoor courts (basketball/futsal/badminton) with sprung wooden flooring; badminton line-marking and nets provided on request, not a dedicated badminton venue.
notes: Hours confirmed on operator site (The Hills Shire Council). Badminton-specific court count (6), sprung timber surface sourced from secondary directories since operator site doesn't break out badminton by name. No pricing found.

name: KGV Recreation Centre
booking_platform: City of Sydney online booking / What's On
access_notes: Run by City of Sydney. Confirmed program is a scheduled casual/social badminton session (Tuesdays 7-9am, all levels), not necessarily open-hours court hire; general facility hours not published. Court count (6) sourced from a secondary directory.
notes: Operator confirms badminton as a bookable casual session. General opening hours and full court-hire pricing not found.

name: Quaycentre
address: Olympic Blvd, Sydney Olympic Park NSW 2127
access_notes: Quaycentre itself is gymnastics/basketball/indoor soccer/netball/volleyball plus hall-of-fame museum; does NOT host badminton. Badminton at Sydney Olympic Park is the separate 'Sports Halls' venue (already covered as a distinct candidate: Sydney Olympic Park Sports Halls) — 12 courts, ~$37/hr, ActiveCarrot booking.
notes: Confirmed directly on operator site that Quaycentre does not offer badminton; do not insert as a badminton venue (Sports Halls entry already covers SOP badminton).

name: St Marys Indoor Sports & Recreation
address: 20 Forthorn Pl, North St Marys NSW 2760
access_notes: Operated as 'National Indoor Sports St Marys'. Four-court facility for cricket, netball, soccer/futsal, touch football, dodgeball; badminton not mentioned anywhere. Weekend hours by appointment only.
notes: Confirmed no badminton offering via operator site and booking platform. Google Places likely mis-tagged.

name: The Y NSW Epping
access_notes: Mixed-purpose multi-sport courts with casual court hire plus organised social badminton nights Mon-Thu. Equipment provided. Exact court count/surface not published.
notes: All facts pulled from operator's own YMCA NSW page and booking platform.

name: Robyn Webster Sports Centre
access_notes: Jointly managed: Inner West Council weekdays 8am-4pm, Sat 8am-12pm, Wed 4pm-10:30pm; Sydney Uni Sport (SUSF) manages other times (phone (02) 9351 4978, email rwsc@sport.usyd.edu.au). Sprung wooden flooring, 8 badminton courts alongside volleyball/futsal/netball. Nearest station Wolli Creek.
notes: Facts confirmed on Inner West Council's own venue page. Full weekly opening hours and pricing not published there.

name: Gameday ANZ
access_notes: Operator's own site confirms indoor courts for badminton, pickleball, and basketball 'under one roof'. Exact court count, surface, per-hour pricing, and full weekly hours not published (only bulk court-hire credit packages listed). A secondary source mentioned 8 badminton courts, 10am-11pm daily, but not corroborated on operator's own site — omitted pending confirmation.
notes: Badminton offering confirmed directly, but detailed specs require follow-up call to 0410 466 760.

name: St Clair Leisure Centre
access_notes: Operated by Ripples NSW / Penrith City Council. Recently renovated sports hall available for regular and casual hire, but no source lists badminton as an offered sport — a secondary directory explicitly lists only basketball for this venue.
notes: No evidence of badminton found across operator page or secondary directories. Given as a general-purpose basketball-oriented sports hall, not a badminton venue.
